answer_1.quote: We consider five datasets covering varied downstream tasks and output formats in order to reproduce the variety of missions they can encounter. • GSM8K ) is a famous mathematical reasoning benchmark where the task involves solving grade school-level math word problems. The output is a free text, typically a detailed solution or numerical answer. • CommonSenseQA (CsQA)  is a multiple-choice question benchmark that tests commonsense reasoning and general understanding abilities of the model. The output is one selected option from five possible choices. • LAMBADA , a language modeling benchmark focused on text understanding and completion, where the task is to predict the final word of a passage based on its context. The output is a single word. • MMLU Pro (Wang et al., 2024)-an enhancement of Massive Multitask Language Understanding (MMLU)  dataset-evaluates models on a wide range of academic and professional subjects. The task consists of answering multiple-choice questions, with the output being one selected option from up to ten possible choices. • CNN/Daily Mail (CNN/DM)  dataset is used for text summarization tasks, where the goal is to generate concise summaries of news articles. The output is free text in the form of a summary.
answer_1.outputs: free text, multiple-choice selections, single word prediction, summaries

answer_2.quote: The accuracy is reported for all datasets except CNN/DM, where we evaluate the ROUGE-1 score.
